items.html: Also know that it has been explained regarding the matter of Sabbath, that all the grip of the shells on the day of Sabbath is in NHY, which are the legs of ZA alone, which rise on the day of Sabbath above their place, and then a vacant place and a space remain, in the secret of “whoever profanes it shall surely be put to death.” And therefore ZA is called amputated, in the secret of these legs that were amputated and rose above to their place as above, and only the aforementioned Kav descends.
